guarded_patterns.explanation: A credential value in a command line is captured in the agent transcript, shell history, and ps output regardless of which executable receives it.

redirect.reason_template: This command contains what looks like a real GitHub token. Secrets are handled BY REFERENCE, never by value: pass the OpenBao path (secret/<cluster>/<app>/<key>) or the command that fetches it (e.g. `gh auth token`) instead of the credential itself. If you must show a credential works, record the RESULT of the check, not the credential. Deliberate test fixture? Use a placeholder-shaped value (e.g. ghp_ followed by x's) or include gitleaks:allow in the command. See the Hard prohibitions section of ~/CLAUDE.md.

guarded_patterns.explanation: A PEM private key written or echoed through a command line lands in the agent transcript, shell history, and logs in full.

redirect.reason_template: This command contains what looks like a real PEM private key. Keys are handled BY REFERENCE, never by value: materialize them from OpenBao into a mode-600 destination (secret/<cluster>/<app>/<key>) instead of embedding the key itself in a command. Deliberate test fixture? Put a placeholder marker (e.g. YOUR_KEY_HERE) within the key body or include gitleaks:allow in the command. See the Hard prohibitions section of ~/CLAUDE.md.
